items.source: AopConfigException - in case of invalid advice
items.translation: AopConfigException - 在建议无效的情况下

items.source: It can be necessary to expose the proxy if an advised object needs to invoke a method on itself with advice applied. Otherwise, if an advised object invokes a method on this, no advice will be applied.
items.translation: 如果建议对象需要应用建议来调用其自身的方法，则可能需要暴露代理。否则，如果建议对象调用 `this` 上的方法，则不会应用任何建议。

items.source: This will be wrapped in a DefaultPointcutAdvisor with a pointcut that always applies, and returned from the getAdvisors() method in this wrapped form.
items.translation: 这将被包装在 `DefaultPointcutAdvisor` 中，其切点始终适用，并以这种包装形式从该类的 `getAdvisors()` 方法返回。

items.source: Note: If the advisor is an IntroductionAdvisor and the replacement is not or implements different interfaces, the proxy will need to be re-obtained or the old interfaces won't be supported and the new interface won't be implemented.
items.translation: 注意：如果顾问是IntroductionAdvisor，而替换对象不是或实现了不同的接口，则必须重新获取代理，否则旧接口将不再受支持且新接口不会被实现。

items.source: The Advisor may be an IntroductionAdvisor, in which new interfaces will be available when a proxy is next obtained from the relevant factory.
items.translation: 顾问可能是 `IntroductionAdvisor`，在这种情况下，当从相关工厂获取下一个代理时，新的接口将可用。

items.source: Only works if the configuration isn't frozen.
items.translation: 仅在配置未冻结时有效。

items.source: Default is false, for optimal performance.
items.translation: 默认值为false，以获得最佳性能。

items.source: Getting the proxy is analogous to an EJB calling getEJBObject().
items.translation: 获取代理类似于 EJB 调用getEJBObject()。

items.source: The default implementation delegates to getAdvisors().length.
items.translation: 默认实现委托给getAdvisors().length。

items.source: This will be wrapped in a DefaultPointcutAdvisor with a pointcut that always applies, and returned from the getAdvisors() method in this wrapped form.
items.translation: 这将被包装在一个始终适用的 DefaultPointcutAdvisor 中，并以这种包装形式从本类的getAdvisors()方法返回。

items.source: Note that the given advice will apply to all invocations on the proxy, even to the toString() method! Use appropriate advice implementations or specify appropriate pointcuts to apply to a narrower set of methods.
items.translation: 请注意，给定的建议将适用于代理上的所有调用，甚至包括 `toString()` 方法！请使用适当的切面实现或指定仅适用于更窄方法集的切入点。

items.source: Note: The given advice will apply to all invocations on the proxy, even to the toString() method! Use appropriate advice implementations or specify appropriate pointcuts to apply to a narrower set of methods.
items.translation: 注意：给定的建议将适用于代理上的所有调用，甚至包括 `toString()` 方法！请使用适当的切面实现或指定仅应用于更窄方法集的切入点。

items.source:
Any AOP proxy obtained from Spring can be cast to this interface to
allow manipulation of its AOP advice.
items.translation: 从 Spring 获取的任何 AOP 代理都可以强制转换为该接口，以便操纵其 AOP 建议。

items.source: Will not include the target class, which may also be proxied.
items.translation: 不会包含目标类，该目标类也可能被代理。

items.source:
Default is "false". Set this to "true" if the advisors have been
pre-filtered already, meaning that the ClassFilter check can be skipped
when building the actual advisor chain for proxy invocations.
items.translation: 默认为 "false"。如果顾问（advisors）已经过预过滤，请将此值设置为 "true"，这意味着在构建代理调用的实际顾问链时可以跳过 ClassFilter 检查。

items.source: The return value of this method can be used to index into the advisors array.
items.translation: 该方法的返回值可用于对顾问数组进行索引。

items.source: Set whether the proxy should be exposed by the AOP framework as a ThreadLocal for retrieval via the AopContext class.
items.translation: 设置 AOP 框架是否将代理作为 `ThreadLocal` 暴露，以便通过 `AopContext` 类进行检索。

items.source: Return the TargetSource used by this Advised object.
items.translation: 返回此Advised对象使用的TargetSource。

items.source: As toString() will normally be delegated to the target, this returns the equivalent for the AOP proxy.
items.translation: 由于 `toString()` 通常会委托给目标对象，因此此处返回的是 AOP 代理的等效结果。

items.translation: 返回建议配置是否已冻结，如果是，则无法进行任何建议更改。
